dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of liquor do you prefer?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Me...? Beer. I don't like it that much though...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: It's just that... beggars can't be choosers...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: As long as it gets me drunk, it's all good... Don't you agree?
